classification: DIAGNOSTIC / EXPLORATORY. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Not a confirmatory crossover pass. Not latent-strategy work.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-22, following the sealed DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1_SPEC 200k run + n=64 eval (EXPLORATORY NEGATIVE, commit f54c0ac9): training win rate collapsed from ~0.56 to ~0.00 while the shared-network teacher loss was active, and only partially recovered (0.006->0.333) once lambda decayed to 0, without returning to baseline by 200k steps. PI diagnosis: catastrophic interference from training ATTACK and DEFEND behavior inside the SAME shared network parameters -- 'No teacher loss on ATTACK does not mean ATTACK is protected... the update appears to have overwritten the strong generalist behavior.' PI-directed fix: physically separate the two roles into two networks rather than retuning lambda on the same shared architecture ('I would NOT just lower lambda yet. That would be guessing.').

SUPERSEDES.verbatim_rule_being_superseded: A single role-conditioned network (role bit concatenated into the actor) plays BOTH ATTACK and DEFEND, supervised by a DEFEND-gated auxiliary N'-teacher loss layered on top of the ordinary (ungated) main PPO loss.
SUPERSEDES.exception_fired: PI, 2026-09-22: the shared-network design is retired for the ATTACK/DEFEND split going forward -- the DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1 sealed run and its negative result remain the record of exactly why. This spec does not delete or invalidate that record; it supersedes the shared-network ARCHITECTURE for this specific research line only.

THE_HYPOTHESIS: Does physically separating ATTACK (a frozen, unmodified copy of the original pi_A) from DEFEND (a separately trained network, warm-started from the same pi_A checkpoint, supervised by the already-validated N' teacher plus ordinary PPO reward) avoid the shared-parameter interference that collapsed the single-network attempt? This is the first question in the sequence; a positive result licenses evaluating the resulting composite team, and a negative result would indicate role-conditioned PPO is destructive under this allocator/training regime independent of network sharing -- neither outcome is assumed here.

ARCHITECTURE_locked.pi_A_frozen: the pinned, unmodified pi_A checkpoint (WARM_START_locked below), loaded as a second, independent SharedActorCentralizedCritic instance, role_conditioning_enabled=False (plays its own native behavior, unaware roles exist). requires_grad_(False) on every parameter immediately after loading; .eval() mode; NEVER added to any optimizer's param_groups; NEVER appears in any loss term of any kind. Used ONLY to produce the executed action for whichever agent slots CLOSEST_DEFENDS assigns to ATTACK this episode.
ARCHITECTURE_locked.pi_D: a trainable SharedActorCentralizedCritic, role_conditioning_enabled=True (same architecture DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1 used), warm-started from the SAME pi_A checkpoint via the existing zero-init role-column expansion. Used to produce the executed action for whichever agent slots CLOSEST_DEFENDS assigns to DEFEND this episode. Its own forward pass still computes outputs for ALL agent slots each tick (the model architecture has no partial-team inference path); only its DEFEND-slot outputs are ever executed or trained.
ARCHITECTURE_locked.allocator: CLOSEST_DEFENDS, unchanged from DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1 / CLOSEST_DEFENDS_SCREEN_4V4: k=N/2 living agents closest to own_flag_home, role_fixed_for_episode=True (assigned exactly once per episode, never reassigned on death/revival).

SPLICE_MECHANISM_locked.when: every rollout-collection tick, BEFORE env.step -- never as a post-hoc overwrite of an already-committed action.
SPLICE_MECHANISM_locked.how: pi_D.act(obs, return_per_agent=True) and pi_A_frozen.act(obs) (under torch.no_grad()) are both computed on the SAME observation batch. The executed action tensor is built by torch.where over a role-broadcast mask: DEFEND-role agent slots take pi_D's own proposed action verbatim (never overridden), ATTACK-role agent slots take pi_A_frozen's proposed action. This executed (spliced) tensor -- not pi_D's raw unspliced proposal -- is what is passed to env.step_async AND what is stored as the buffer's actions field, so every stored (action, log_prob) pair always corresponds to the policy that actually produced it.
SPLICE_MECHANISM_locked.log_prob_provenance: pi_D's per-agent log-prob decomposition (SharedActorCentralizedCritic._log_prob_entropy_per_agent, new in this spec) is evaluated against pi_D's OWN proposed action tensor. Because DEFEND-slot actions are never overridden, this is automatically valid against the executed action for those slots. The DEFEND-role-gated sum of this per-agent log-prob (rl.custom_ppo.rollout.collector.RolloutCollector._splice_split_attack_defend_actions) is stored as the new buffer field defend_log_probs; pi_D's log-prob for ATTACK slots (which would be measuring 'how likely would pi_D have produced pi_A_frozen's action', a meaningless quantity for PPO's ratio) is computed but never stored or used anywhere.
SPLICE_MECHANISM_locked.not_done: actions are never generated by one policy alone and then partially overwritten by another after the fact -- overwriting after log-probs/values were already computed against the pre-overwrite action would store a (action, log_prob) pair that does not correspond to the same policy, exactly the failure mode the PI flagged.

LOSS_locked.main_ppo_actor_loss_and_entropy: gated to DEFEND-role agent slots only (rl.custom_ppo.update.minibatch_updater, new in this spec): model.evaluate_actions(..., return_per_agent=True) yields per-agent log-prob/entropy; both are reduced to a scalar by summing ONLY the DEFEND-role agents' contribution (obs_roles < 0.5, the buffered per-step role mask), replacing the previously-joint (all-agent) scalar fed into ppo_policy_loss and the entropy bonus. ATTACK-slot log-prob/entropy is computed (the forward pass cannot avoid it) but discarded, never backpropagated.
LOSS_locked.value_loss: UNCHANGED, team-level, ungated. A single centralized critic V(s) estimates expected team reward independent of which network produced which action; this is unaffected by the split and requires no restructuring (confirmed by code reconnaissance before implementation).
LOSS_locked.teacher_loss: rl.custom_ppo.defend_teacher.py, REUSED UNCHANGED. Its existing DEFEND-role + decision-eligible + alive gate already scopes it correctly to exactly the agent slots pi_D is responsible for; per the PI, 'No ATTACK masking gymnastics are needed anymore because the attacker network is physically separate and immutable.'
LOSS_locked.lambda_schedule: REUSED UNCHANGED from DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1_SPEC's LAMBDA_SCHEDULE_locked (flat 0.1 for [0,50000), linear decay to 0.0 over [50000,150000], flat 0.0 for [150000,200000]). Per the PI: the fix is architectural, not a smaller lambda on the same broken setup -- 'I would NOT just lower lambda yet. That would be guessing.' The first split-policy attempt reuses the exact schedule already implemented and tested, changing exactly one axis (network sharing) at a time.

WARM_START_locked.used_for_both: pi_A_frozen loads this checkpoint directly (role_conditioning_enabled=False, no expansion). pi_D warm-starts from the SAME checkpoint via the existing zero-init role-column expansion mechanism (role_conditioning_enabled=True) -- the identical warm-start DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1 used and already verified (C6/C7, max_logit_diff=0.0, argmax_diff=0, fresh Adam survives migration). Both networks start IDENTICAL to native pi_A at step 0; only pi_D's parameters then diverge under training.

EXECUTION_BOUNDARY_locked.training_time: pi_A_frozen and pi_D both run every tick; pi_A_frozen's forward pass is training-only infrastructure (never trained, never touched by any optimizer) but IS part of the live team's behavior during rollout collection.
EXECUTION_BOUNDARY_locked.at_evaluation: NO N' controller, NO teacher loss. The greedy CLOSEST_DEFENDS allocator (fixed_for_episode) + the frozen pi_A (ATTACK slots) + pi_D's own final trained checkpoint (DEFEND slots) compose the evaluated team. This is the ruthless endpoint: pi_D's own learned behavior, under the allocator and alongside the untouched original attacker, is what gets scored.

TRAINING.seed_class: exploratory (single seed; reserved via seed_registry before the first GPU step, exactly like every prior seed in this line)

SINGLE_AXIS_v1.change_only: network sharing: ATTACK and DEFEND now live in two physically separate networks (one frozen, one trained) instead of one shared role-conditioned network. Everything else -- allocator, role-fixed-for-episode semantics, teacher formula, teacher cadence, lambda schedule, opponent, total timesteps, warm-start source -- is reused unchanged from DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1.
held_fixed: no GETFLAG preservation / sibling-separation / role-preservation losses
no 1,000,000-step budget for this first attempt
N' teacher formula, cadence, and lambda schedule, byte-identical to DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1

CONTRACTS_before_training: C1 pi_A checkpoint (used for BOTH pi_A_frozen and pi_D's warm-start) equals its pin
C2 fixed_for_episode role hold semantics (reused unchanged from DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1, already contracted)
C3 teacher parity: N'-port bit-identical to the sealed controller (reused unchanged, already contracted)
C4 teacher loss gating: DEFEND-role + decision-eligible + alive only (reused unchanged, already contracted)
C5 lambda schedule exact boundary values (reused unchanged, already contracted)
C6 warm-start t0 equivalence for pi_D: pi_D,t0(.|o,r=0)=pi_D,t0(.|o,r=1)=pi_A(.|o) exactly (reused mechanism, already contracted)
C7 fresh optimizer / global_step / RNG identity after the architecture migration (reused mechanism, already contracted)
C8 pi_A_frozen NEVER receives gradient: parameters bit-identical before and after both rollout collection AND a full PPO update step (new -- the central contract of this spec)

C9 main PPO actor loss and entropy bonus are DEFEND-role-gated only: verified via the per-agent log-prob decomposition (sums to the joint value; act() and evaluate_actions() agree) and via C8's own empirical confirmation that pi_A_frozen's exclusion from the gate produces zero gradient in practice

C10 no post-hoc overwrite: the executed action tensor is built by torch.where BEFORE env.step, and the buffer's stored actions/defend_log_probs correspond to the policy that actually produced the executed action (structural: verified by reading the collector's own splice ordering, not by output inspection alone)

C11 mutual exclusion: getflag_preserve_lambda, sibling_sep_lambda, role_pres_lambda all exactly 0/disabled for this run; split_attack_defend guarded both directions against SAPPO/EXP2/sibling/role_pres/getflag runners

C12 structurally absent when disabled: split_attack_defend_enabled=False reproduces DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1 bit-for-bit (no frozen model loaded, no splicing, no per-agent loss path taken)
C13 read-only-adjacent fence: contracts themselves consume no training step and write no checkpoint

EVALUATION_after_training_not_during.instrument: experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py, extended if needed for a two-model (frozen ATTACK + trained DEFEND) evaluated team; role allocator (fixed_for_episode CLOSEST_DEFENDS) ACTIVE; no teacher, no N'.
EVALUATION_after_training_not_during.reading_rule_exploratory: point-estimate evidence on whether the split-policy composite team (frozen pi_A ATTACK + trained pi_D DEFEND) moves toward the scaffold's own signature relative to frozen pi_B -- NOT a confirmatory pass. A separate, larger reserved block is required before any confirmatory claim.
EVALUATION_after_training_not_during.narrow_claim_if_promising: physically separating ATTACK and DEFEND into two networks avoided the catastrophic interference the shared-network attempt showed, in this first 200k exploratory run -- NOT that the composite team is proven competitive, NOT that 6v6 is addressed, NOT a license to scale to 1M steps without a fresh decision.

EXPLICITLY_FORBIDDEN: a 1,000,000-step run as the first attempt of this architecture
any confirmatory specialization claim from this first 200k run
any change to pi_B, either certified pole, or any sealed prior record in this line
combining this arm with GETFLAG preservation, sibling-separation, or role-preservation losses
retuning the teacher lambda schedule, cadence, or formula in this same run as a substitute for the architectural fix -- that is exactly the guess the PI explicitly declined to make
letting pi_A_frozen's parameters be touched by any optimizer, ever, for any reason
evaluating before training writes its final checkpoint
reserving or spending the training or evaluation seed before contracts pass
porting to 6v6 before this 4v4 attempt is interpreted
claiming PAPER-FAITHFUL, Summer-faithful, or any latent-strategy relevance -- this program does not use the latent z system
KNOWN_LIMITATION_ACKNOWLEDGED: pi_D still processes the full 4-agent observation batch every tick (the model architecture has no partial-team inference path), including ATTACK-role slots whose output is discarded and never trained -- wasted compute, not a correctness issue, but a known inefficiency versus a purpose-built 2-agent defender network. This spec does not attempt that optimization; if the split-policy approach succeeds, a leaner pi_D architecture is a separate, later design question.
